critical_code_review_comments: Firewall middleware runs on every /api request - good security design
Network admins bypass IP/geo rules but NOT brute force or rate limiting - correct implementation
Geo-blocking uses ip-api.com free API with 1-hour cache - production-ready
In-memory caches for rules, settings, rate limits, login attempts - good for performance
Security logs include IP, geolocation, timestamps, event details - comprehensive audit trail
